name: Gemini in Chrome
desc: Gemini built into the Chrome browser to answer and act on pages
desc_zh: 内置在 Chrome 里、可读网页并代为操作的 Gemini
solves: Looking things up means leaving the page for a chatbot; Gemini answers and navigates inside the browser.
solves_zh: 查资料要离开网页去问聊天机器人，Gemini 直接在浏览器里回答和导航。
best_for: You are comparing two tabs of specs and want the differences pointed out on the page.
best_for_zh: 正对着两个标签页比较参数，想让差异直接在页面上标出来。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://gemini.google/release-notes (official Gemini Apps release updates)）。 Outside the window. The entry is dated 2026.01.28 and says the rollout starts 'tomorrow', so 2026-01-29 is inferred from the official text. Google AI Pro or Ultra subscribers in the US with English Chrome. No dedicated product page found (gemini.google/chrome returns 404), so the homepage is the Gemini app. Second source is not independent media. 首次公开日期来源：https://gemini.google/release-notes
